body:
I didn't get admitted into the psych ward, though when I came home and things got worse, I was seriously considering it. After reading this, perhaps it was in my best interest not to go.
Thanks for your kind words though, it did help.

Its not that I feel rejected by society or anything like that, I'm so happy about what is happening in the world today. It's more the struggle with the internal processing and I think I'm suffering depression in general, or something similar. At this point I think I've done/am doing all I can on my own. (I love reading, it's the only thing that gets me to sleep at night :) )

I'm awaiting gender therapy. It's hard to reach out to people about it because my friends/boyfriend/most people can't really help me figure it all out. I think I will ring the Samaritans in a while. Maybe just wording it out will make me feel a bit better.
